correctness.rationale: For Cr_n=K_nn minus matching, a set is total dominating iff it contains >=2 vertices from EACH side. A total-coalition partition must have every block not dominating yet some distinct partner that takes both counts to >=2. Deficit epsilon=2n-number_of_blocks bounds non-singleton sizes. For n>=5, any optimum with deficit<=4 must contain U and V singletons; each needs a distinct (1,2) or (2,1) triple, exhausting deficit and fixing all remaining blocks singleton. Cases n=3,4 require separate combinatorial finite profiles. Count n>=5 as C(n,1)C(n,2)C(n-1,2)C(n-2,1)=[n(n-1)(n-2)/2]^2. Independent exhaustive graph-adjacency partition enumeration tested all 203, 4140, 115975 unlabeled-block partitions at n=3,4,5 and recovered (TC,M)=(3,48),(4,857),(6,900). No claim finite enumeration proves all n; general proof uses deficit argument.
